checklist.fail_action: correct: Flux is an idea/content engine, NOT a knit compiler (a render carries no stitch count/GG/yarn count/measurement/shrinkage); 'build our own machine' = NEVER (highest-confidence do-not, ~$2M-10M+ vs sub-$20k used); AI is a MULTIPLIER on the scarce programmer/linker/inspector, never a substitute; AI-design->knit-program autonomy is [UNKNOWN], test don't assume; the content edge is an EDGE not a moat.

checklist.check: the load-bearing UNKNOWNs and the relevant DECISION_MEMO gate are surfaced
checklist.fail_action: name the UNKNOWN(s) the answer leans on (knit+LINK rate G2, live CAC G1, working-capital size G3, anti-pill-on-our-fabrics G4, AI-program autonomy, name + hype signal G8, forward duty G5) and point to the gate they map to, rather than papering over them.

checklist.check: if the question touches viability, the answer carries the GATED-conditional-GO posture, not a naive yes
checklist.fail_action: re-frame any viability answer to: dead as first drawn; exactly one inverted config closes the math; inventory cash FORBIDDEN until G1-G4 pass; the single tie-breaker is live blended CAC [UNKNOWN] under ~$35 organic-led; a failed CAC test / non-passing pilling grade / unfundable working-capital cycle is a REAL NO-GO, a number to obey, not to argue around.

neutralize_gate.outcome: return only a draft that passes N1-N7; otherwise revise and re-run the gate.

tag_legend.[FACT]: cited public source or true-by-definition identity; treat as a citeable anchor (e.g. the duty trio, the de-minimis repeal EO 14324 eff. 2025-08-29, the MPF cap $33.58-$651.50, ISO/USTER standards, the disclosed firm figures).
tag_legend.[ESTIMATE]: carries method + basis + confidence and the literal word estimate; a hypothesis to harden or refute. Variants: [ESTIMATE: industry-lore, <confidence>] = trade-craft convention; [ESTIMATE: discussion/industry-lore] = off-paper mechanism described structurally, never as a named-party accusation.
tag_legend.[UNKNOWN]: not reliably known; a valid, frequent answer that is named as a blocker and never fabricated.
tag_legend.untagged: dimensional identities (unit definitions, count conversions like Tex = 1000/Nm = 590.5/Ne, Nm = 1.693xNe) are true by definition and carry no tag.

honesty_discipline.coverage_is_a_floor: coverage is a floor, not a ceiling: when a number is missing the brain says so and names it as a blocker rather than inventing one; honesty discipline never excuses indecision, but a verdict never claims more certainty than its inputs support.
governing_blockers: the Ludhiana knit+LINK per-piece job-work rate [UNKNOWN]
honesty_discipline.binding_rule: honesty tags travel downstream with every claim; treat every [FACT] as a citeable anchor and every [ESTIMATE] as a hypothesis to harden or refute; off-paper material stays mechanism, never accusation; contribution margin after CAC (not gross margin) is the D2C viability test (SCOPE_GLOSSARY rule #8, LTV:CAC > ~3).
